rounds.note_en: Leonardo announced a signed five-year facility to refinance debt repaid in January 2026. Drawdown is undisclosed. Mandated lead arrangers and bookrunners named in the release are BBVA Milan, Banco BPM, Santander and its Milan branch, BNP Paribas Italian Branch and BNL, BPER, CaixaBank Italy, Commerzbank Milan, Crédit Agricole CIB Milan, Deutsche Bank Luxembourg, Intesa Sanpaolo, Société Générale Milan and UniCredit. Crédit Agricole CIB and BNP Paribas coordinated ESG. UniCredit acts as documentation and facility agent.

sources.title: Leonardo announces EUR600m ESG-linked term loan

rounds.note_en: Coca-Cola HBC confirmed by 25 October 2023 that it had invested in Manna Aero through its Ventures arm. The date is the public disclosure date. The exact transaction date, amount, instrument and other participants are undisclosed.

sources.title: Coca-Cola HBC confirms investment in Manna Aero
